instruction:
AutoCAD is the required application; open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\panel_layout.dxf. Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.

Import panel_layout.dxf. Draw a 240 x 120 control panel from (0,0) to (240,120) on OUTLINE. Add six diameter 12 holes in a 3 by 2 grid at x=50, 120, 190 and y=40, 80. Add CENTER grid lines x=50,120,190 from y=20 to y=100 and y=40,80 from x=30 to x=210, and add text ACAD-37. Use OUTLINE for the control panel, HOLE for holes, CENTER for grid lines, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
